verses.en: And it came to pass, after the year was expired, at the time when kings go forth to battle, that David sent Joab, and his servants with him, and all Israel; and they destroyed the children of Ammon, and besieged Rabbah. But David tarried still at Jerusalem.
verses.pt: E aconteceu à volta de um ano, no tempo que saem os reis à guerra, que Davi enviou a Joabe, e a seus servos com ele, e a todo Israel; e destruíram aos amonitas, e puseram cerco a Rabá: mas Davi se ficou em Jerusalém.
verses.en_web: At the return of the year, at the time when kings go out, David sent Joab, and his servants with him, and all Israel; and they destroyed the children of Ammon, and besieged Rabbah. But David stayed at Jerusalem.
verses.en_bbe: Now in the spring, at the time when kings go out to war, David sent Joab and his servants and all Israel with him; and they made waste the land of the children of Ammon, and took up their position before Rabbah, shutting it in. But David was still at Jerusalem.

verses.en: And it came to pass in an eveningtide, that David arose from off his bed, and walked upon the roof of the king’s house: and from the roof he saw a woman washing herself; and the woman was very beautiful to look upon.
verses.pt: E aconteceu que levantando-se Davi de sua cama à hora da tarde, passeava-se pelo terraço da casa real, quando viu desde o terraço uma mulher que se estava lavando, a qual era muito bela.
verses.en_web: At evening, David arose from his bed and walked on the roof of the king’s house. From the roof, he saw a woman bathing, and the woman was very beautiful to look at.
verses.en_bbe: Now one evening, David got up from his bed, and while he was walking on the roof of the king's house, he saw from there a woman bathing; and the woman was very beautiful.

verses.en: And David sent and enquired after the woman. And one said, Is not this Bath-sheba, the daughter of Eliam, the wife of Uriah the Hittite?
verses.pt: E enviou Davi a preguntar por aquela mulher, e disseram-lhe: Aquela é Bate-Seba filha de Eliã, mulher de Urias Heteu.
verses.en_web: David sent and inquired after the woman. One said, “Isn’t this Bathsheba, the daughter of Eliam, Uriah the Hittite’s wife?”
verses.en_bbe: And David sent to get knowledge who the woman was. And one said, Is this not Bath-sheba, the daughter of Eliam and wife of Uriah the Hittite?

verses.en: And David sent messengers, and took her; and she came in unto him, and he lay with her; for she was purified from her uncleanness: and she returned unto her house.
verses.pt: E Davi enviou mensageiros, e tomou-a: e assim que entrou a ele, ele dormiu com ela. Purificou-se logo ela de sua imundícia, e se voltou à sua casa.
verses.en_web: David sent messengers, and took her; and she came in to him, and he lay with her (for she was purified from her uncleanness); and she returned to her house.
verses.en_bbe: And David sent and took her; and she came to him, and he took her to his bed: (for she had been made clean;) then she went back to her house.

verses.en: And the woman conceived, and sent and told David, and said, I am with child.
verses.pt: E concebeu a mulher, e enviou-o a fazer saber a Davi, dizendo: Eu estou grávida.
verses.en_web: The woman conceived; and she sent and told David, and said, “I am with child.”
verses.en_bbe: And the woman became with child; and she sent word to David that she was with child.

verses.en: And David sent to Joab, saying, Send me Uriah the Hittite. And Joab sent Uriah to David.
verses.pt: Então Davi enviou a dizer a Joabe: Envia-me a Urias Heteu. E enviou-o Joabe a Davi.
verses.en_web: David sent to Joab, “Send me Uriah the Hittite.” Joab sent Uriah to David.
verses.en_bbe: And David sent to Joab saying, Send Uriah the Hittite to me. And Joab sent Uriah to David.

verses.en: And when Uriah was come unto him, David demanded of him how Joab did, and how the people did, and how the war prospered.
verses.pt: E quando Urias veio a ele, perguntou-lhe Davi pela saúde de Joabe, e pela saúde do povo, e também da guerra.
verses.en_web: When Uriah had come to him, David asked him how Joab did, and how the people fared, and how the war prospered.
verses.en_bbe: And when Uriah came to him, David put questions to him about how Joab and the people were, and how the war was going.

verses.en: And David said to Uriah, Go down to thy house, and wash thy feet. And Uriah departed out of the king’s house, and there followed him a mess of meat from the king.
verses.pt: Depois disse Davi a Urias: Desce à tua casa, e lava teus pés. E saindo Urias de casa do rei, veio atrás dele um presente real.
verses.en_web: David said to Uriah, “Go down to your house and wash your feet.” Uriah departed out of the king’s house, and a gift from the king was sent after him.
verses.en_bbe: And David said to Uriah, Go down to your house and let your feet be washed. And Uriah went away from the king's house, and an offering from the king was sent after him.

verses.en: But Uriah slept at the door of the king’s house with all the servants of his lord, and went not down to his house.
verses.pt: Mas Urias dormiu à porta da casa do rei com todos os servos de seu senhor, e não desceu à sua casa.
verses.en_web: But Uriah slept at the door of the king’s house with all the servants of his lord, and didn’t go down to his house.
verses.en_bbe: But Uriah took his rest at the door of the king's house, with all the servants of his lord, and did not go down to his house.

verses.en: And when they had told David, saying, Uriah went not down unto his house, David said unto Uriah, Camest thou not from thy journey? why then didst thou not go down unto thine house?
verses.pt: E fizeram saber isto a Davi, dizendo: Urias não desceu à sua casa. E disse Davi a Urias: Não vieste de caminho? Por que, pois, não desceste à tua casa?
verses.en_web: When they had told David, saying, “Uriah didn’t go down to his house,” David said to Uriah, “Haven’t you come from a journey? Why didn’t you go down to your house?”
verses.en_bbe: And when word was given to David that Uriah had not gone down to his house, David said to Uriah, Have you not come from a journey? why did you not go down to your house?

verses.en: And Uriah said unto David, The ark, and Israel, and Judah, abide in tents; and my lord Joab, and the servants of my lord, are encamped in the open fields; shall I then go into mine house, to eat and to drink, and to lie with my wife? as thou livest, and as thy soul liveth, I will not do this thing.
verses.pt: E Urias respondeu a Davi: A arca, e Israel e Judá, estão debaixo de tendas; e meu senhor Joabe, e os servos de meu senhor sobre a face do campo: e havia eu de entrar em minha casa para comer e beber, e a dormir com minha mulher? Por vida tua, e pela vida de tua alma, que eu não farei tal coisa.
verses.en_web: Uriah said to David, “The ark, Israel, and Judah, are staying in tents; and my lord Joab and the servants of my lord, are encamped in the open field. Shall I then go into my house to eat and to drink, and to lie with my wife? As you live, and as your soul lives, I will not do this thing!”
verses.en_bbe: And Uriah said to David, Israel and Judah with the ark are living in tents, and my lord Joab and the other servants of my lord are sleeping in the open field; and am I to go to my house and take food and drink, and go to bed with my wife? By the living Lord, and by the life of your soul, I will not do such a thing.

verses.en: And David said to Uriah, Tarry here to day also, and to morrow I will let thee depart. So Uriah abode in Jerusalem that day, and the morrow.
verses.pt: E Davi disse a Urias: Fica-te aqui ainda hoje, e amanhã te despedirei. E ficou Urias em Jerusalém aquele dia e o seguinte.
verses.en_web: David said to Uriah, “Stay here today also, and tomorrow I will let you depart.” So Uriah stayed in Jerusalem that day, and the next day.
verses.en_bbe: And David said to Uriah, Be here today, and after that I will let you go. So Uriah was in Jerusalem that day and the day after.

verses.en: And when David had called him, he did eat and drink before him; and he made him drunk: and at even he went out to lie on his bed with the servants of his lord, but went not down to his house.
verses.pt: E Davi o convidou, e fez-lhe comer e beber diante de si, até embriagá-lo. E ele saiu à tarde para dormir em sua cama com os servos de seu senhor; mas não desceu à sua casa.
verses.en_web: When David had called him, he ate and drink before him; and he made him drunk. At evening, he went out to lie on his bed with the servants of his lord, but didn’t go down to his house.
verses.en_bbe: And when David sent for him, he took meat and drink with him, and David made him the worse for drink: and when evening came, he went to rest on his bed with the servants of his lord, but he did not go down to his house.

verses.en: And it came to pass in the morning, that David wrote a letter to Joab, and sent it by the hand of Uriah.
verses.pt: Vinda a manhã, escreveu Davi a Joabe uma carta, a qual enviou por mão de Urias.
verses.en_web: In the morning, David wrote a letter to Joab, and sent it by the hand of Uriah.
verses.en_bbe: Now in the morning, David gave Uriah a letter to take to Joab.

verses.en: And he wrote in the letter, saying, Set ye Uriah in the forefront of the hottest battle, and retire ye from him, that he may be smitten, and die.
verses.pt: E escreveu na carta, dizendo: Ponde a Urias diante da força da batalha, e desamparai-o, para que seja ferido e morra.
verses.en_web: He wrote in the letter, saying, “Send Uriah to the forefront of the hottest battle, and retreat from him, that he may be struck, and die.”
verses.en_bbe: And in the letter he said, Take care to put Uriah in the very front of the line, where the fighting is most violent, and go back from him, so that he may be overcome and put to death.

verses.en: And it came to pass, when Joab observed the city, that he assigned Uriah unto a place where he knew that valiant men were.
verses.pt: Assim foi que quando Joabe cercou a cidade, pôs a Urias no lugar de onde sabia que estavam os homens mais valentes.
verses.en_web: When Joab kept watch on the city, he assigned Uriah to the place where he knew that valiant men were.
verses.en_bbe: So while Joab was watching the town, he put Uriah in the place where it was clear to him the best fighters were.

verses.en: And the men of the city went out, and fought with Joab: and there fell some of the people of the servants of David; and Uriah the Hittite died also.
verses.pt: E saindo logo os da cidade, lutaram com Joabe, e caíram alguns do povo dos servos de Davi; e morreu também Urias Heteu.
verses.en_web: The men of the city went out, and fought with Joab. Some of the people fell, even of David’s servants; and Uriah the Hittite died also.
verses.en_bbe: And the men of the town went out and had a fight with Joab: and a number of David's men came to their death in the fight, and with them Uriah the Hittite.

verses.en: Then Joab sent and told David all the things concerning the war;
verses.pt: Então enviou Joabe, e fez saber a Davi todos os negócios da guerra.
verses.en_web: Then Joab sent and told David all the things concerning the war;
verses.en_bbe: Then Joab sent David news of everything which had taken place in the war:

verses.en: And charged the messenger, saying, When thou hast made an end of telling the matters of the war unto the king,
verses.pt: E mandou ao mensageiro, dizendo: Quando acabares de contar ao rei todos os negócios da guerra,
verses.en_web: and he commanded the messenger, saying, “When you have finished telling all the things concerning the war to the king,
verses.en_bbe: And he gave orders to the man who took the news, saying, After you have given the king all the news about the war,

verses.en: And if so be that the king’s wrath arise, and he say unto thee, Wherefore approached ye so nigh unto the city when ye did fight? knew ye not that they would shoot from the wall?
verses.pt: Se o rei começar a irar-se, e te disser: Por que vos aproximastes à cidade lutando? Não sabíeis que eles costumam atirar do muro?
verses.en_web: it shall be that, if the king’s wrath arise, and he asks you, ‘Why did you go so near to the city to fight? Didn’t you know that they would shoot from the wall?
verses.en_bbe: If the king is angry and says, Why did you go so near the town for the fight? was it not certain that their archers would be on the wall?

verses.en: Who smote Abimelech the son of Jerubbesheth? did not a woman cast a piece of a millstone upon him from the wall, that he died in Thebez? why went ye nigh the wall? then say thou, Thy servant Uriah the Hittite is dead also.
verses.pt: Quem feriu a Abimeleque filho de Jerubusete? Não lançou uma mulher do muro um pedaço de uma roda de moinho, e morreu em Tebes? Por que vos aproximastes ao muro? Então tu lhe dirás: Também teu servo Urias Heteu é morto.
verses.en_web: Who struck Abimelech the son of Jerubbesheth? Didn’t a woman cast an upper millstone on him from the wall, so that he died at Thebez? Why did you go so near the wall?’ then you shall say, ‘Your servant Uriah the Hittite is also dead.’”
verses.en_bbe: Who put Abimelech, the son of Jerubbaal, to death? did not a woman send a great stone down on him from the wall, putting him to death at Thebez? why did you go so near the wall? Then say to him, Your servant Uriah the Hittite is among the dead.

verses.en: So the messenger went, and came and shewed David all that Joab had sent him for.
verses.pt: E foi o mensageiro, e chegando, contou a Davi todas as coisas a que Joabe lhe havia enviado.
verses.en_web: So the messenger went, and came and showed David all that Joab had sent him for.
verses.en_bbe: So the man went, and came to David, and gave him all the news which Joab had sent him to give; then David was angry with Joab and said, Why did you go so near the town for the fight? was it not certain that their archers would be on the wall? who put Abimelech, the son of Jerubbaal, to death? did not a woman send a great stone down on him from the wall, putting him to death at Thebez? why did you go so near the wall?

verses.en: And the messenger said unto David, Surely the men prevailed against us, and came out unto us into the field, and we were upon them even unto the entering of the gate.
verses.pt: E disse o mensageiro a Davi: Prevaleceram contra nós os homens, que saíram a nós ao campo, bem que nós lhes fizemos retroceder até a entrada da porta;
verses.en_web: The messenger said to David, “The men prevailed against us, and came out to us into the field, and we were on them even to the entrance of the gate.
verses.en_bbe: And the man said to David, Truly the men got the better of us, and came out against us into the open country, but we sent them back to the very doors of the town.

verses.en: And the shooters shot from off the wall upon thy servants; and some of the king’s servants be dead, and thy servant Uriah the Hittite is dead also.
verses.pt: Porém os flecheiros atiraram contra teus servos desde o muro, e morreram alguns dos servos do rei; e morreu também teu servo Urias Heteu.
verses.en_web: The shooters shot at your servants from off the wall; and some of the king’s servants are dead, and your servant Uriah the Hittite is also dead.”
verses.en_bbe: And the archers sent their arrows at your servants from the wall, and some of the king's servants are dead, and among them is your servant Uriah the Hittite.

verses.en: Then David said unto the messenger, Thus shalt thou say unto Joab, Let not this thing displease thee, for the sword devoureth one as well as another: make thy battle more strong against the city, and overthrow it: and encourage thou him.
verses.pt: E Davi disse ao mensageiro: Dirás assim a Joabe: Não tenhas pesar disto, que de igual e semelhante maneira costuma consumir a espada: esforça a batalha contra a cidade, até que a rendas. E tu conforta-o.
verses.en_web: Then David said to the messenger, “Tell Joab, ‘Don’t let this thing displease you, for the sword devours one as well as another. Make your battle stronger against the city, and overthrow it.’ Encourage him.”
verses.en_bbe: Then David said to the man, Go and say to Joab, Do not let this be a grief to you; for one man may come to his death by the sword like another: put up an even stronger fight against the town, and take it: and do you put heart into him.

verses.en: And when the wife of Uriah heard that Uriah her husband was dead, she mourned for her husband.
verses.pt: E ouvindo a mulher de Urias que seu marido Urias era morto, fez luto por seu marido.
verses.en_web: When Uriah’s wife heard that Uriah her husband was dead, she mourned for her husband.
verses.en_bbe: And when the wife of Uriah had news that her husband was dead, she gave herself up to weeping for him.

verses.en: And when the mourning was past, David sent and fetched her to his house, and she became his wife, and bare him a son. But the thing that David had done displeased the LORD.
verses.pt: E passado o luto, enviou Davi e recolheu-a à sua casa: e foi ela sua mulher, e deu-lhe à luz um filho. Mas isto que Davi havia feito, foi desagradável aos olhos do SENHOR.
verses.en_web: When the mourning was past, David sent and took her home to his house, and she became his wife, and bore him a son. But the thing that David had done displeased Yahweh.
verses.en_bbe: And when the days of weeping were past, David sent for her, and took her into his house, and she became his wife and gave him a son. But the Lord was not pleased with the thing David had done.
